categoryColor.title: Color for “{name}”
categoryColor.description: Pick a new display color for this category. It updates everywhere the category appears — charts, legends and lists.
categoryColor.invalid: Enter a valid hex color, e.g. #22C55E
categoryColor.error: Failed to save the color. Please try again.

chat.disclosure: Your questions and the data the assistant looks up (redacted transaction descriptions, amounts, balances) are sent to the AI model provider configured in {provider} on this computer. The model has no access to your computer or database; the server runs every lookup read-only.
chat.disabled: Chat is turned off. To enable it, set CHAT_ENABLED=true in the server's .env, configure Hermes (or Kiro) and CHAT_DB_URL as described in the README, and restart the app.
chat.empty: Ask anything about your finances — answers are based on the data in this app.
chat.exampleQuestion: e.g. “How much did I spend on groceries last month?” or “Which merchant did I pay the most this year?”
chat.error: Something went wrong sending the message. Please try again.
chat.memberScope: Answers are limited to the household member selected in the filter.

errors.disabled: Chat is turned off on the server (CHAT_ENABLED).
errors.not-local: Chat is available only from this computer.
errors.rate-limited: Too many questions in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.config: Chat is not configured correctly on the server. Check the CHAT_* settings and the server log.
errors.db: The read-only chat database connection is not available. Check CHAT_DB_URL and the finance_chat_ro role.
errors.cli-missing: The AI assistant program (Hermes/Kiro) was not found on the server. Install it or set CHAT_CLI_PATH.
errors.not-logged-in: The AI assistant is not logged in to a model provider. Run `hermes doctor` / `hermes login` on the host.
errors.timeout: The assistant took too long to answer. Try again or ask a simpler question.
errors.output-limit: The assistant produced too much output. Ask a narrower question.
errors.cli-error: The AI assistant failed to answer. Check its login on the host and try again.
errors.bad-output: The assistant replied in an unexpected format. Try again or rephrase.
errors.max-rounds: The question needed too many data lookups. Try a narrower question.
errors.interrupted: The server restarted before this question was answered. Try again.
errors.busy: A question in this conversation is still being answered. Wait for it to finish.
errors.not-found: This conversation no longer exists. Start a new one.
errors.idempotency-conflict: This question could not be sent. Please type it again.
errors.unknown: The question failed unexpectedly. Try again.

chat.waitForAnswer: Waiting for the answer… you can leave this page and come back.
chat.conversationsHint: Pick a saved conversation or start a new one.

rules.autoDesc: Auto-categorize all future transactions matching {merchant} as {category}? Existing uncategorized transactions will be updated too.
rules.title: Categorization Rules
rules.description: Transactions whose description matches a pattern are categorized automatically. Higher priority wins.
rules.errValidation: Please provide a pattern and choose a category.

settings.bankConnectionsDesc: Connect Israeli bank and credit card accounts. The first successful sync imports all history available from the provider; later syncs check the last 7 days.
settings.syncComplete: Sync complete: {creds} credentials processed, {accounts} accounts and {txns} transactions upserted, {rules} rules applied, and {llm} categorized by Kiro.
settings.syncDeferred: Connection saved. Isracard needs the host browser, so its first import runs with the next host sync (npm run sync:once).
settings.syncAlreadyRunning: A sync is already running (scheduled or from another window). Wait for it to finish, then try again.
settings.fieldsHint: Only fill in the fields required by the chosen provider — for example, most banks use username and password, while card issuers may need national ID and the last 6 digits of the card.
settings.viewOnlyHint: Recommended: create a view-only (צפייה בלבד) secondary user at your bank and connect with it — the app only needs read access, and a view-only user can never transfer money.
settings.deleteConnDesc: The stored credentials for {provider} ({member}) will be permanently deleted. Transactions already imported are kept, but syncing will stop until you reconnect.
settings.securityText: Bank credentials are encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM before being stored in the database, and are never sent back to the browser — only the provider name and the connected household member are shown here.
settings.errChooseMemberProvider: Please choose a household member and a provider.
settings.errInitialSync: Connection saved, but its initial sync failed. Check the details below and retry Sync Now.
settings.errCredentialSyncBusy: Another sync is already running, so the connection was not saved. Try again when it finishes.

members.title: Household Members
members.description: Members appear in the header filter and own bank connections. A member with active bank connections cannot be deleted.
members.name: Name
members.deleteDesc: {name} will be permanently removed from the household. Members with active bank connections cannot be deleted.
